[[Crypt Slasher]]s are undead [[Dervish]]es that can be found in various locations in the [[Depths of Tyria]]. Above ground, a number of them guard a group of [[skeleton]]s in [[Varajar Fells]].

==Notes==
*Like most [[Zombie]]s, Crypt Slashers take double damage from [[holy damage]] and are not immune to [[bleeding]], [[poison]] or [[disease]]; and whom leave corpses when they die.
*Striking them in [[melee]] will inflict [[Disease]] on the attacker, much like the effect of [[Tainted Flesh]].
